AiLikelihood.description: How strongly the discovery signals suggest a resource is AI (architecture section D).
AiLikelihood.title: AiLikelihood

AppliesCondition.description: Why an `APPLIES_TO` edge is conditional rather than in force or upcoming (ADR 0019).
AppliesCondition.title: AppliesCondition

AssuranceLevel.description: The assurance ladder (ADR 0005). Ordered, so `level >= L2_EVIDENCED` works.
AssuranceLevel.title: AssuranceLevel

Purpose.description:
Why a system processes a dataset. `training` means this system itself runs training;
`TRAINED_ON` is model lineage (ADR 0012).
Purpose.title: Purpose

Resolution.description: How a control's assessment was found for a scope.
Resolution.title: Resolution

Role.description: Role under the EU AI Act. `any` is for requirements that are not role-based.
Role.title: Role

SnapshotCrosswalk.description:
Requirement R of one framework related to requirements of another through a hub control.
A pair of frameworks has a row for each requirement that reaches the other.
SnapshotCrosswalk.title: SnapshotCrosswalk

SnapshotObligation.description: One row of `obligations_for(system)`. The mapping itself is the MAPS_TO edge.
SnapshotObligation.title: SnapshotObligation

SnapshotRedaction.description: What redaction did, as counts. Never a value.
SnapshotRedaction.title: SnapshotRedaction

Source.description: Where a record came from. One value maps to one provenance badge (D12).
Source.title: Source

StrmType.description: NIST IR 8477 set theory relationship types.
StrmType.title: StrmType

VerifiedAgainst.description:
What a requirement's wording was checked against (ADR 0017). ISO entries are always
`public_listing`, so nothing implies a check against the standard itself.
VerifiedAgainst.title: VerifiedAgainst

description:
What `verity export` writes. Everything in it is a public field of the graph, or derived
from the graph by the one assessment run named by `header.as_of`.
title: Snapshot
